---
title: "Tutorial"
description: "A model-first SCNSim course from an explicit circuit and diagram to Views, parameter points, reuse, and pump-off HB."
anchor-sections: false
---

The numbered files are complete, clean-kernel Chapters in a `CONVERGING`
course candidate. Each declares the circuit it needs before selecting a View,
parameter point, or request. Authoring figures are real SVG exports from the
corresponding source checkpoints; their evidence does not establish execution
of every cell or scientific correctness. Generated notebooks remain zero-output
review artifacts, and the website does not execute kernels or solvers.

::: {.callout-warning title="TARGET course · CONVERGING" appearance="simple"}
Structured authoring, parameter binding, and certified diagrams are proposed
API surfaces. Direct/HB, View, optimization, workspace, Result, and report
meanings remain their established numerical teaching; a diagram never chooses
an analytical View or performs a calculation. Authoring figures and reported
compiled-diagram limitations are distinct; neither is whole-course acceptance
or a release claim.
:::
